span.p:
IMPORT
create · create-from-anki
Anki only: creates the file.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
— / RESURRECT (force)
missing · bidirectional-sync
force: RESURRECT
File gone: Sync decides, forcing re-creates it. Forced: re-creates the file you deleted.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CHECK
quiet · bidirectional-sync
Both sides match: rewrites nothing. Forced: rewrites the same content.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PULL
overwrite · bidirectional-sync
Newer in Anki: overwrites your file.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
— / FORCE_PULL (force)
skip · create-in-anki
force: FORCE_PULL
Newer in Obsidian: skipped, use Sync. Forced: overwrites your newer edits.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
— / FORCE_PULL (force)
conflict · bidirectional-sync
force: FORCE_PULL
Edited in both: newest wins on Sync. Forced: overwrites your newer edits.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ENROLL
quiet · enroll-in-anki
Has an id but no record: enrols it, rewrites the same file.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
—
create · create-in-anki
Vault only: the export wizard creates it.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ENROLL
quiet · enroll-in-anki
Has an id but no record: enrols it, rewrites the same file.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
—
missing · bidirectional-sync
Gone from Anki: Sync deletes the file.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
—
missing · cleanup-vault
Only a stale record left: Purge ledger forgets it.
